title: Ibinyejana Cyenda by'Umuhamagaro
intro: Tekereza uhagaze wenyine uhanganye n'umuraba w'agashinyaguro igihe kirekire kuruta uko ubwami buzamuka bukanagwa, buhamagara ijoro n'amanywa mu gihe amatwi yabo apfutse kandi imyenda yabo ikururwa neza. Imbere hari ubwato bwubatswe ku butaka bwumutse no mu mazi butari bwarigeze bubaho mbere. Ese urabona kwihangana kuri iyi marato y'ubutumire?
clues: Natumiye abantu banjye ijoro n'amanywa, mu ibanga no ku mugaragaro, gusenga Allah wenyine.
Abantu banjye binjiza intoki mu matwi, bakenyera imyenda yabo kugira ngo banyirukane.
Namaze imyaka magana icyenda na mirongo itanu ndi mu bantu banjye mbahamagarira kuyoborwa.
Nakoze igikoresho munsi y'amaso ya Allah n'ibyahishuwe mu gihe abantu banjye bansekaga ku butaka bwumutse.
Nategetswe gutwara mu bwato amabiri abiri y’ubwoko bwose n’abizera igihe itegeko ryazaga maze ifuru irasendera.
Narebye imiraba izamuka nk'imisozi ubwo umwuzure warohamaga abanze, mu gihe Allah yarokoye abari mu nkuge.
